extra_checks.why: Healthy link at fastest poll must never trip: tick advances every 100ms so 1-2 polls may see same tick, timeout 0.35s must not false-trip
Healthy link at slowest poll must never trip: interval 500ms exceeds 0.35s timeout but tick jumps ~5 per poll so != proves freshness
Stale frozen tick with minimal over-voltage at slowest poll must still trip within 500ms via fail-safe latch
